questions.question: How many elements are there in the modern periodic table?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** 118.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The modern periodic table consists of 118 elements.**
 
• These elements are arranged in order of **increasing atomic number.**
 
• The periodic table is divided into groups and periods, with elements in the** same group having similar chemical properties.**
 
• The periodic table is a fundamental tool in chemistry, helping scientists predict the behavior of elements and compounds.

questions.question:
As per Article 279A of the amended Constitution of India, the GST Council which will be a joint forum of the Centre and the States, shall consist of the following members:

(i) Union Finance Minister

(ii) The Union Minister of State, in-charge of Revenue or finance

(iii) The Minister In-charge of finance or taxation or any other Minister nominated by each State Government
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** (i), (ii) and (iii).**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The correct answer is option 3, which means that the GST Council will consist of the Union Finance Minister, the Union Minister of State in charge of Revenue or Finance, and the Minister In-charge of Finance or taxation or any other Minister nominated by each State Government**
 
• ** Article 279A** of the amended Constitution of India is a significant provision that **establishes the GST Council as a joint forum of the Centre and the States for the purpose of GST implementation.**
 
• The GST Council is responsible for** making recommendations on important issues such as GST rates, exemptions, thresholds, and the division of GST revenue between the Centre and the States.**
 
• The GST Council plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth implementation of GST and resolving any issues that may arise between the Centre and the States.
 
• The inclusion of both the Union Finance Minister and the Union Minister of State in charge of Revenue or finance in the GST Council ensures that the Centre's perspective is adequately represented, while the Ministers nominated by each State Government ensure that the States have a say in GST-related matters.

questions.question: 4 kilo calories of energy is released by _______
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** one gram of protein.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **One gram of protein releases 4 kilo calories of energy when metabolized.**
 
• This is because proteins are made up of** amino acids, which can be broken down and used by the body for energy**.
 
• One grams of fat also release 9-kilo calories of energy, as fats are a concentrated source of energy.
 
• One gram of sugar releases only 3.87 kilo calories of energy, as it is a simpler carbohydrate that is quickly metabolized by the body.
 
• 3 grams of protein would release 12-kilo calories of energy, which is three times the amount stated in the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Proteins **are essential macronutrients that are important for** building and repairing tissues in the body.**
 
• They are made up of amino acids, which are** linked together by peptide bonds.**
 
• Fats are also important macronutrients that provide energy, support cell growth, and protect organs.
 
• They are composed of **fatty acids and glycerol.**
 
• Sugars, or carbohydrates, are another important source of energy for the body.
 
• They are broken down into glucose, which is used by the cells for energy.
 
• Four grams of fat is equivalent to about one teaspoon of oil or butter.

questions.question: Which article of Indian Constitution provides for right to freedom of speech?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**19.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points____ **__

__
 
• **Article 19 of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to freedom of speech and expression to all citizens of India.**
 
• This right includes the freedom to express opinions, ideas, and information through any medium, such as speech, writing, printing, or any other means.
 
• The Constitution also allows reasonable restrictions on this **right in the interest of sovereignty, integrity, security, public order, morality, or decency.**
 
• The right to freedom of speech and expression is considered one of the most fundamental rights in a democratic society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Option 2:** Article 21** of the Indian Constitution provides the** right to life and personal liberty.**
 
• Option 3:** Article 21A **of the Indian Constitution provides the** right to education.**
 
• Option 4**: Article 20 **of the Indian Constitution protects against** double jeopardy and self-incrimination.**

questions.question: Which of the following is an extension of the Indian Ocean?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**Arabian Sea.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points____ **__

 
• **The Indian Ocean is the world's third-largest ocean and covers 70,560,000 square kilometers.**

 
 
• The Arabian Sea is an extension of the Indian Ocean located between the Arabian Peninsula and the Indian subcontinent.
 
 
 
• ** The Aral Sea**, on the other hand, is a landlocked sea located between** Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan in Central Asia.**
 
 
• **​** It was once one of the largest lakes in the world but has shrunk significantly due to irrigation projects and other human activities.
 
 
 
• ** The Yellow Sea **is a marginal sea located between** China and Korea **and is connected to the** East China Sea and the Bohai Sea.**
 
• T**he Caribbean Sea** is located in the Western Hemisphere, bounded by the **Caribbean islands and Central and South America.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2, Arabian Sea, as it is the only option extending the Indian Ocean.

questions.question: A famous Tamil epic, the Silappadikaram was composed by a poet named Ilango, around ________ years ago.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1800.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 3, 1800 years ago.**
 
• **Silappadikaram is a famous Tamil epic that tells the story of Kannagi,** a woman who seeks justice for her husband's wrongful execution.
 
• The epic was composed by** Ilango Adigal, a Tamil poet and prince who lived during the Sangam period in South India**.
 
• The Sangam period is a period of** ancient Tamil history that lasted from the 3rd century BCE to the 4th century CE.**
 
• Option 1 (3000 years ago) and option 4 (2600 years ago) are too early for the Sangam period, while option 2 (2200 years ago) is too late for Ilango Adigal's lifetime.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Sangam literature is a collection of Tamil poems and epics composed during the Sangam period.
 
• The Sangam literature is divided into the** Ettuthogai (Eight Anthologies) and the Pattupattu (Ten Idylls).**
 
• The Silappadikaram is one of the** Five Great Epics of Tamil literature,** along with** Manimekalai, ****Civaka Cintamani, ****Cilappatikaram, Valayapathi and Kundalakesi.**
 
• The Silappadikaris are notable for their vivid descriptions of Tamil culture, society, and religion during the Sangam period.

questions.question: Makar Sankranti is celebrated by the Sindhi community by which of the following names?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tirmoori.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Makar Sankranti is a Hindu festival that marks the transition of the sun into the zodiac sign of Makara (Capricorn).**
 
• It is celebrated across India with different names and traditions.
 
• **The Sindhi community celebrates Makar Sankranti as Teejri, which is also known as Tirmoori in some regions.**
 
• ** Lal Loi** is another festival celebrated by the** Sindhi community, which falls on the same day as Makar Sankranti but has different rituals and significance**.
 
• ** Thadri is **a festival celebrated by the Sindhi community to protect themselves from **monsoon-related diseases.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tirmoori is a Sindhi term that means sesame seeds,** which are an essential ingredient in the traditional sweets prepared during the festival.
 
• Teejri is derived from the word 'Teej', which means the third day after a whole moon night, and it falls on the third day of the dark fortnight of the month of Bhadrapada.
 
• Lal Loi is also known as Lohri in some regions and is celebrated by lighting bonfires and offering prayers to the God of Fire.
 
• Thadri is celebrated in the month of Bhadon (August-September) and is dedicated to Goddess Jog Maya, who is believed to protect people from the diseases caused by the monsoon season.

questions.question: How many players on each side are allowed on the field at a time in the game of Kabaddi?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** 7.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The correct answer to the question is option 1, i.e., 7 players on each side are allowed on the field at a time in the game of Kabaddi.**
 
• **Kabaddi **is a contact sport that originated in ancient India and is **played between two teams of seven players each.**
 
• The objective of the game is for a player, **known as the raider, to enter the opposing team's half of the court, tag as many defenders as possible, and return to their own half without getting tackled by the defenders**.
 
• The defenders, on the other hand, **aim to stop the raider by tackling them before they can return to their own half**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer to the question is option 1, i.e., 7 players on each side are allowed on the field at a time in the game of Kabaddi.

questions.question: The total value of _______ goods and services produced in a year, indicates national income.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** final.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct option is option 3 - final goods.**
 
• Final goods refer to those goods that are meant for** final consumption and not for resale or further processing.**
 
• The total value of final goods and services produced in a year is known as Gross Domestic Product (GDP), which is a measure of the country's economic performance.
 
• Hence, the statement is correctly answered as option 3 - final goods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Intermediary goods (option 1) **are those goods that are used in the production of other goods and services and do not have any value in themselves. They are not included in the calculation of GDP.
 
• **Unfinished goods (option 2) are goods** that are still in the process of being manufactured and do not have any final value yet. They are also not included in the calculation of GDP.
 
• **Commercial goods (option 4) refer to goods** that are used for commercial purposes and can include both final and intermediary goods. This option is not correct as it is too broad and does not specify whether the goods are final or intermediary.

questions.question: After Independence, Indian Parliament has accepted the _________ pattern of society as the objective of social and economic policy.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** socialist.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian Parliament has accepted the socialist pattern of society as the objective of social and economic policy, as stated in the Directive Principles of State Policy in the Indian Constitution.**
 
• This means that the government's policies aim to reduce social and economic inequalities and promote **social justice through measures such as progressive taxation, land reforms, and welfare schemes for marginalized sections of society.**
 
• This socialist approach is also reflected in the nationalization of key industries, such as banking, insurance, and telecommunications, and the promotion of public sector enterprises.
 
• However, India's economic policies have also undergone liberalization and globalization since the 1990s, emphasizing market-oriented reforms and private-sector participation.
 
• The capitalist and communist options do not apply to India's economic policies, as they represent extreme ends of the ideological spectrum that do not align with India's mixed economy and democratic socialism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capitalism is an economic system based on private ownership of the means of production and distribution of goods and services, focusing on profit maximization and market competition.** 

 
 
• Free markets, individual rights, and limited government intervention characterize this system.
 
 
 
• **Liberalism **is a political and economic philosophy emphasizing individual** freedom, equality, and the rule of law. In the economic context, it supports free markets, private property, and limited government intervention.**
 
• ** Communism** is a social and economic system based on common ownership of the **means of production and the absence of social classes and private property. This system comprises central planning, state control, and collective decision-making.**
